**Description**ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10: 'No more variables left in this MIB View
test_nbr_health.py fail over python3 issue:
ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10: 'No more variables left in this MIB View

<!--
Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
run test_nbr_health.py

**Describe the results you received:**

```
def test_neighbors_health(duthosts, localhost, nbrhosts, eos, sonic, enum_frontend_dut_hostname):
...
 if isinstance(nbrhost, EosHost):
>               failmsg = check_snmp(k, v['mgmt_addr'], localhost, eos['snmp_rocommunity'], True)
...
"/tmp/ansible_snmp_facts_payload_vv8s4kzw/ansible_snmp_facts_payload.zip/ansible/modules/snmp_facts.py\"
, line 1018, in <module>\n  File \"/tmp/ansible_snmp_facts_payload_vv8s4kzw/ansible_snmp_facts_payload.zip/ansible/modules/snmp_facts.py\"
, line 668, in main\nValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10: 'No more variables left in this MIB View'\n"
```


**Describe the results you expected:**
test passes without test issues.

comments.author: SavchukRomanLv
comments.body:
Hi @wsycqyz we still observe issue, with python2 TC passed. 
When run at Python3  defaultdict(<function main.<locals>.Tree at 0x7f461433a670>, {'address': 'No more variables left in this MIB View', 'interface': 'No more variables left in this MIB View', 'netmask': 'No more variables left in this MIB View'}) 
this part added to ipv4_networks in snmp_facts.py  and TC failed as can not convert 'No more variables left in this MIB View' to int

@yxieca @wangxin can smbd take a look?
